name: Vila
bio: Archetype: Multitarget Healing, Cleanser, Mental-Oriented Buff. ⌽ Grants a crit-focused ST buff, Mental Damage characters gain a stronger buff. ⌽ Heals the team passively when not actively casting incantations. ⌽ Provides even more passive healing during Ult and empowers her ST heal to proc an additional two times. ⌽ Gives Moxie and [Eureka] to a unit of your choice after using Ult. ⌽ While Ult is in effect, her buff also boosts skill scaling (higher Rank skills = higher bonus).
